query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `contentPackages` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `clientId` int NOT NULL,
  `crmClientId` int NOT NULL,
  `savedKeywordId` int,
  `keyword` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('generating','pending_review','pending_approval','approved','published','failed','rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'generating',
  `blogContentId` int,
  `blogTitle` varchar(500),
  `blogExcerpt` text,
  `videoScript` text,
  `heygenVideoId` varchar(255),
  `heygenVideoStatus` enum('not_started','processing','completed','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_started',
  `heygenVideoUrl` text,
  `heygenThumbnailUrl` text,
  `socialCaptionsJson` text,
  `emailSubject` varchar(255),
  `emailBody` text,
  `errorMessage` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `approvedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `publishedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `notification_logs` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `type` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `channel` enum('email','sms','push','in_app') NOT NULL,
  `recipient` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(500),
  `body` text,
  `status` enum('sent','failed','suppressed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sent',
  `suppressed` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `suppression_reason` varchar(255),
  `lead_id` int,
  `metadata` text,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `email_templates` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `campaign_type` varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `name` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `from_address` varchar(320) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tim@lockinloans.com',
  `subject` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `html` text NOT NULL,
  `category` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
  `is_active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `inbound_emails` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `from_email` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `from_name` varchar(200),
  `to_email` varchar(320),
  `subject` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `html_body` text,
  `lead_id` int,
  `assigned_to` varchar(320),
  `is_read` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `is_replied` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `replied_at` timestamp NULL,
  `reply_body` text,
  `message_id` varchar(500),
  `in_reply_to` varchar(500),
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
